<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Trunks' Ship''' is [[Special:MyLanguage/Trunks|Trunks]]' time machine, landed somewhere on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. Trunks trains anyone regardless of alignment and runs the Precision minigame.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here == <!--T:6-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''[[Special:MyLanguage/Trunks|Trunks]]''' teaches ki skills, ki attacks and sword strikes such as the [[Special:MyLanguage/Shining Sword Attack|Shining Sword Attack]], and runs the '''Precision''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|training minigame]]. He has no alignment requirement.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
The ship generates once per world, in land biomes. [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistants]] can sell a '''Trunks' Time Machine Map''' at trade tier 4, for 1 Iron Sword and an empty Map. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate trunks_ship}}. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Finding structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:10-->
Like every master's home, the ship can't be damaged by ki attacks (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:11-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:12-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]] quest 16, ''The Time Machine'': find Trunks' Ship.
</translate>
